observations.summary: Avoid chemical drain openers for a clogged drain; instead use boiling water or a drain snake. Pouring toxins down the drain can kill the organisms that treat waste and harm the septic system.

Drain opener harmful ingredients are hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, potassium hydroxide and sodium hydroxide (lye); burns to eyes may cause permanent vision loss; skin burns; call 911 or the Poison Help hotline after exposure.
observations.inference_limit: Medical encyclopedia summary; no treatment advice reproduced.
